name: selects the longest matching token at each cursor
emits one unknown marker per unmatched character
input: recognized characters separated by punctuation, plus an empty vocabulary
test:
assert tokenize_longest_match('a?b!', ['a', 'b'], unknown='<U>') == ['a', '<U>', 'b', '<U>']
assert tokenize_longest_match('hi', [], unknown='?') == ['?', '?']
assert tokenize_longest_match('', ['a']) == []

name: matches Unicode text without normalizing or folding case
input: Unicode vocabulary with overlapping entries and an unmatched symbol
test:
assert tokenize_longest_match('猫猫🌙A', ['猫', '猫猫', '🌙', 'a']) == ['猫猫', '🌙', '<UNK>']
assert tokenize_longest_match('naïve', ['na', 'ï', 've']) == ['na', 'ï', 've']
